description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#724: https's own exports are Node's (no http classes), https.Server chains to tls.Server with http.Server's connection methods, Node's http defaults and ALPN (http/1.1 unless ALPNProtocols or an ALPNCallback is given), and https.request with no agent of its own is an http.ClientRequest on https.globalAgent with OutgoingMessage's header API, its headers sent from end() on, a Headers object ignored, a null value kept and an undefined one thrown, as Node's; net, tls, https and http servers have Node's own allowHalfOpen and listeners; one destroyed before it goes out, and one to a port nothing listens on, end with Node's events
